title: Massive chip sell-off sinks the tech sector and the Nasdaq 100 enters official correction
summary: The Nasdaq 100 falls into correction territory as semiconductor stocks plummet on concerns about artificial intelligence spending and Chinese competition.

title: Apple reaches $5 trillion in market cap and surpasses Nvidia as the world's largest company
summary: Apple becomes the second company in history to surpass $5 trillion in market value, reaching a new all-time high and dethroning Nvidia.

title: Oil plunges 8% after US-Iran military pause in the Strait of Hormuz
summary: Crude oil prices fall sharply after the US and Iran agreed to halt attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, while gold rises on geopolitical uncertainty.

title: Coca-Cola earns 17% more in the first half and raises its forecasts for 2026
summary: The company posted a profit of $8.349 billion through July, beating market estimates, and improved its outlook for the full year.

title: Boeing reduces losses and beats revenue forecasts on higher deliveries
summary: The aerospace manufacturer cut its losses to $435 million in the first half, boosted sales by 11% and generated positive cash flow for the first time.

title: Barclays earns 19% more in the first half and expects higher revenue, though the stock falls
summary: The British bank posted a profit of $4.191 billion in the first half, driven by growth across all its business divisions.

title: SpaceX shares lose more than $1.2 trillion in value and fall to all-time lows
summary: SpaceX plummets on the stock market amid the tech sector sell-off, erasing more than $1.2 trillion in market capitalization.

title: Bitcoin and cryptocurrencies fall on tech plunge, Fed and CLARITY Act
summary: Cryptocurrencies are dragged down by the massive sell-off in technology stocks, expectations for the Fed meeting and regulatory uncertainty in the US.

title: Ibex 35 rises 0.2% and dodges global tech declines on a day of uncertainty
summary: The Spanish benchmark posts slight gains in a session marked by geopolitical uncertainty in the Middle East and expectations for the Federal Reserve.

title: Market expects Fed to hold rates despite inflation, but Citadel forecasts a hike
summary: Investors expect the Federal Reserve to keep interest rates unchanged at its July meeting, though hedge fund Citadel predicts a surprise increase.
